title: Bar Salts Blue Sour Raspberry Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Blue Sour Raspberry flavour concentrate combines the bright, tangy essence of blue raspberry with a sour kick, creating an exhilarating vape experience. This 30ml flavour concentrate provides a 100% PG base, perfect for those who enjoy a sharp, flavourful DIY e-liquid with a pronounced character. Ideal for both newcomers and seasoned mixologists, this concentrate allows you to tailor your vaping experience by adjusting the flavour intensity and nicotine content as desired. Incorporate this concentrate into your chosen VG/PG blend to achieve the perfect balance of flavour and vapour. Recommended dilution rates are between 15-20%, depending on how strong you like your flavours. Each bottle is crafted under strict quality control in the UK, ensuring you receive only the finest product for your DIY e-liquid creations. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
